app.name: Peer Vault Relay
app.subtitle: Relay admin
login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter the admin token to manage this relay.
error.notFound.title: Page not found
error.notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.
error.general.title: Something went wrong
error.general.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
error.network: Cannot reach the relay. Check your connection and try again.
error.session: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.missing: It no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
error.server: The relay answered with an error ({{status}}).
login.hint: The token is only sent to sign in and is never stored in this browser.
login.wrongToken: That admin token is not correct.
logout.title: Sign out everywhere?
logout.description: Signing out ends every admin session at once, including those in other browsers and on other devices. Everyone will need the admin token to sign in again.
overview.description: Whether anything needs your attention, and how the relay is used.
overview.pending.title: {{count}} device(s) waiting for approval
overview.pending.body: They cannot sync until you approve them. Compare each fingerprint with the one shown on the device.
overview.pending.label: Waiting for approval
overview.clear.title: Nothing needs your attention
overview.clear.body: No device is waiting for approval.
peer.col.label: Name
peer.action.label: Rename
peer.done.label: Name saved: {{name}}
peer.approve.title: Approve this device?
peer.approve.description: Open the plugin settings on the device and compare its fingerprint with the one below, group by group. Approve only if every group matches.
peer.revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
peer.revoke.effect: The device is disconnected at once and can no longer connect to this relay. You can re-enable it later.
peer.revoke.keyWarning: It still holds the vault key and the notes it has already synced. Revoking does not take those back.
peer.delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
peer.delete.effect: Removes the device's record and its mailbox acknowledgements, and disconnects it.
peer.delete.reappear: This does not block it: the next time it connects it shows up again as waiting for approval. To keep it out, revoke it instead.
peer.label.title: Rename device
peer.label.description: A name only you see here, to tell devices apart. Leave empty to remove it.
peers.description: Each device has a key pair; it is known here only by its fingerprint.
peers.empty.title: No devices yet
peers.empty.body: In the Obsidian plugin, enter this relay's address ({{url}}). Devices appear here as soon as they connect.
peers.pending.title: Waiting for approval ({{count}})
peers.pending.hint: Compare each fingerprint with the one shown in the plugin on that device.
peers.all.title: All devices ({{count}})
settings.description: Changes apply to every room on this relay.
settings.rejected: The relay rejected a value. Check the ranges and try again.
settings.error.integer: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
settings.group.mailboxHint: Encrypted bundles kept for devices that are offline. The relay cannot read them.
settings.group.turnHint: Lets devices connect when a direct connection is blocked. Both values are needed; leave them empty to turn TURN off.
settings.require_approval.label: New devices need approval
settings.require_approval.help: A device seen for the first time waits until you approve it here.
settings.require_approval.offTitle: Anyone with the vault key can join
settings.require_approval.offBody: New devices become active immediately. If the vault key or setup QR code leaks, an unknown device can sync without you noticing. Devices already waiting are not affected.
settings.max_peers_per_room.label: Devices per room
settings.max_peers_per_room.help: How many devices may be connected to one room at the same time ({{min}}–{{max}}). Extra devices are refused.
settings.mailbox_ttl_days.label: Keep mailbox bundles for (days)
settings.mailbox_ttl_days.help: Bundles older than this are deleted even if a device never picked them up ({{min}}–{{max}}).
settings.mailbox_quota_bytes.label: Mailbox quota per room
settings.mailbox_quota_bytes.help: When a room's mailbox is full, new uploads are refused until space frees up ({{min}}–{{max}}).
settings.audit_ttl_days.label: Keep audit entries for (days)
settings.audit_ttl_days.help: Older entries are deleted by the daily cleanup ({{min}}–{{max}}).
settings.turn_key_id.label: TURN key ID
settings.turn_key_id.help: The TURN key ID from the Cloudflare Realtime dashboard.
settings.turn_api_token.label: TURN API token
settings.turn_api_token.help: Write-only: the stored token is never shown. Type a new one to replace it.
settings.turn_api_token.placeholderRepla: Type a new token to replace it
unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.description: Your changes on this page will be lost.
lang.description: Add interface languages or adjust built-in strings without changing code. Changes reach the dashboard at once; the plugin picks them up when it starts.
lang.addHint: Missing strings fall back to English, so you can translate gradually.
lang.codeHint: Lowercase language, optional subtags, e.g. ja, pt-BR.
lang.codeInvalid: Use 2–3 lowercase letters, optionally followed by -subtags (2–8 letters or digits).
lang.codeTaken: This language already exists. Edit it from the list instead.
lang.name: Display name
lang.nameHint: Shown in the language switcher, ideally in the language itself.
lang.deleteBody: All its translations are removed from the relay. Anyone using it switches back to their default language. This cannot be undone; export it first if you may need it again.
lang.revertBody: Your overrides are removed and the shipped strings are used again.
lang.editorHint: Type a translation next to each English string. Empty fields fall back to the built-in string, then English.
lang.overrideHint: This is a built-in language. Only strings you change are stored as overrides; restore a row to go back to the built-in text.
lang.error.size: Too large: the relay accepts at most 512 KB per language.
lang.error.name: Enter a display name of 1–64 characters.
lang.emptyNs.title: No strings in this part yet
lang.emptyNs.body: The plugin has no interface strings yet. When it does, they appear here automatically.
lang.import.json: This file is not valid JSON.
lang.import.shape: Unexpected format. Use a file exported from this page: {"name", "admin": {…}, "plugin": {…}} with text values.
lang.import.nothing: Nothing to change: the file matches the current translations (unknown keys skipped: {{ignored}}).
lang.import.title: Apply imported translations?
lang.import.changes: {{count}} string(s) will be overwritten with the file's text. Empty values in the file are skipped.
lang.import.ignored: {{count}} key(s) in the file are not used by this version and will be skipped.
lang.import.notSaved: Nothing is saved until you press Save.
audit.description: Who did what and when. No IP addresses and no vault content are ever recorded.
